001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.deciv;
002
003import java.util.Set;
004
005import java.awt.Color;
006
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.FactionAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.BaseIntelPlugin;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.SectorMapAPI;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
016
017public class DecivIntel extends BaseIntelPlugin {
018
019        //protected MarketAPI market;
020        protected SectorEntityToken primary;
021        protected String name;
022        protected FactionAPI faction;
023        protected boolean destroyed;
024        protected boolean warning;
025        
026        public DecivIntel(MarketAPI market, SectorEntityToken primary, boolean destroyed, boolean warning) {
027                //this.market = market;
028                this.primary = primary;
029                this.destroyed = destroyed;
030                this.warning = warning;
031                this.faction = market.getFaction();
032                name = market.getName();
033                
034        }
035        
036        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
037                
038                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
039                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
040                float pad = 3f;
041                float opad = 10f;
042                
043                float initPad = pad;
044                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
045                
046                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
047                
048                bullet(info);
049                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
050                
051//                      info.addPara("Danger level: " + danger, initPad, tc, dangerColor, danger);
052//                      initPad = 0f;
053                
054                unindent(info);
055        }
056        
057        
058        @Override
059        public void createIntelInfo(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
060                Color c = getTitleColor(mode);
061                info.addPara(getName(), c, 0f);
062                addBulletPoints(info, mode);
063        }
064        
065        @Override
066        public void createSmallDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
067                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
068                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
069                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
070                float pad = 3f;
071                float opad = 10f;
072                
073                
074                info.addImage(getFactionForUIColors().getLogo(), width, 128, opad);
075                
076                if (warning) {
077                        info.addPara("Conditions at " + name + ", a colony belonging to " + 
078                                        faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + ", have taken a turn for the worse. Unless the colony " +
079                                        "is stabilized in some way, it's likely to decivilize and be lost completely in the near future.",
080                                        opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
081                } else if (destroyed) {
082                        info.addPara(name + ", a colony formerly belonging to " + 
083                                        faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + ", has been destroyed.",
084                                        opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
085                } else {
086                        info.addPara(name + ", a colony formerly belonging to " + 
087                                        faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + ", has become decivilized. " +
088                                        "Central authority has collapsed completely and irreversibly, with the remaining " +
089                                        "population scrambling to survive.",
090                                        opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
091                }
092                
093                addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
094                
095                addDeleteButton(info, width);
096        }
097        
098        @Override
099        public String getIcon() {
100                return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("intel", "deciv");
101        }
102        
103        @Override
104        public Set<String> getIntelTags(SectorMapAPI map) {
105                Set<String> tags = super.getIntelTags(map);
106                tags.add(Tags.INTEL_DECIVILIZED);
107                return tags;
108        }
109        
110        public String getSortString() {
111                return "Decivilized " + name;
112        }
113        
114        public String getName() {
115                if (warning) {
116                        return name + " - Deterioration";
117                }
118                if (destroyed) {
119                        return name + " - Destroyed";
120                }
121                return name + " - Decivilized";
122        }
123        
124        @Override
125        public FactionAPI getFactionForUIColors() {
126                return faction;
127        }
128
129        public String getSmallDescriptionTitle() {
130                return getName();
131        }
132
133        @Override
134        public SectorEntityToken getMapLocation(SectorMapAPI map) {
135                return primary;
136        }
137        
138        @Override
139        public boolean shouldRemoveIntel() {
140                return false;
141        }
142
143        @Override
144        public String getCommMessageSound() {
145                return super.getCommMessageSound();
146        }
147        
148        
149        
150}
